newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds shed early gains, sentiment weak.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds shed early gains, sentiment weak.

text.p: Austrian bonds eased in post-bourse trade on Wednesday and dealers said the market was struggling to maintain early gains.
A test of German Bund support at 102 considered likely, further undermining sentiment.
"Germany is suffering because of the strong dollar and we are suffering along with them," one trader said.
Little impact seen from U.S. economic data.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 unchanged at 99.90 to yield 5.64 pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.80/88 to yield 5.65/64 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 up five bps at 99.95 to yield 4.63 (4.65) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.90/98 to yield 4.65/63 percent.
* Austrian bond future up seven bps at 109.70 on turnover of 201 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany down one at four bps, five-year spread up one at 18 bps.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.397 and overnight money weaker at 3.13/3.38. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
